subject: Go daddy domain forwarding not working

messages.author: e2ca5093917af03b
messages.subject: Go daddy domain forwarding not working
parts:
I set up dodxdx.com (from godaddy) to forward all traffic to my shiny app.

The problem it is run as a full screen desktop view not as a mobile (narrower) device


See for yourself :

Type
1. dodxtx.com

And separately try

2. https://dodx.shinyapps.io/DoDx5Dyspnea/
The second will run app with a column per screen the first will run all 12 columns per view.

How to fix it? So I get the same results ( 2.) with both links?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Go daddy domain forwarding not working
parts:
That GoDaddy masking feature uses frames to embed the real site. It's not surprising to me that the outer frame distorts the rendering on mobile, as the frame is lacking any <meta> tags for setting the mobile viewport size.

If this needs to work, you are probably better off using the Shinyapps.io custom domain feature (available in the Pro tier I think):
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/custom-domains.html
